title: TWINKIDINKY
summary: A small Jupyter-notebook project with a utils/tabular_utils.py module that builds custom tabular data transformers, importing rdt's Config, BaseTransformer, and various encoder classes (LabelEncoder, BinaryEncoder, UnixTimestampEncoder, FloatFormatter, OneHotEncoder, FrequencyEncoder). RDT's transformer classes and HyperTransformer configuration objects are imported directly and subclassed to build a custom preprocessing pipeline.
